نتحادث (form VI)
# نَتَحَادَثُ (nataḥādaṯu) /na.ta.ħaː.da.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَادَثَ (taḥādaṯa)
# نَتَحَادَثَ (nataḥādaṯa) /na.ta.ħaː.da.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَادَثَ (taḥādaṯa)
# نَتَحَادَثْ (nataḥādaṯ) /na.ta.ħaː.daθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَادَثَ (taḥādaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
